components.css: .ds-triage-card { width: 253px; padding: 10px 12px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #c5c5d5; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-triage-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; margin-bottom: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-triage-title:hover { color: #fd7452; } .ds-next-step { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; padding: 0; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #001360; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-next-step:hover { color: #a9371b; } .ds-next-step:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #001360; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip-request, .ds-chip-promise { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-chip-request { color: #7a3532; background: color-mix(in srgb, #fd7452 18%, transparent); } .ds-chip-promise { color: #001360; background: color-mix(in srgb, #001360 12%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
This fork keeps Project Manager as a vault desk tool: dense, built for scanning first, and warm enough for academic admin work without becoming a productivity dashboard. Triage and Sprint views borrow Obsidian theme tokens for paper and ink, then spend a small accent budget on lane meaning.

The anti-reference is neon productivity apps. Saturated washes, floating card shadows, and tutorial legends on every visit are out of scope. Colour marks debt or progress. It does not decorate empty space.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian theme face and theme tokens first
4% lane tints; flat cards at rest
Accents name state (reply owed, promised, done, waiting), not brand theatre
Soft hover lift; structural shadows on modals only

rules.name: The Four Percent Rule
rules.body: Lane washes mix the lane accent at 4% into transparent (or the theme paper token). Stronger pastel bands are a regression.

rules.name: The Accent Budget Rule
rules.body: Accent colour marks meaning on ≤10% of a triage viewport: lane titles, chips, current steps. The rest stays theme neutral.

rules.name: The Theme Face Rule
rules.body: Prefer the theme face; never invent a display font for plugin chrome.

rules.name: The Flat Card Rule
rules.body: Triage and matrix cards ship without resting box-shadow. Modals may use ambient shadow.

dos: Do use Obsidian theme and text tokens for paper, borders, and body ink.
Do keep lane washes at 4% and cards flat at rest.
Do spend Terracotta and Ink Navy on debt meaning; Sage on done.
Do make the next actionable child the primary control on Email triage cards.
Do hide chips with a zero count.
donts: Don't hardcode #ffffff card fills or decorative resting shadows on triage cards.
Don't raise lane washes into pastel dashboard bands.
Don't invent a display font for plugin chrome.
Don't put a permanent Legend strip on Email triage once chips are self-describing.
Don't restain Sprint quadrant paper with a second wash system.
